seo.title: Smart Card Issuance Platform: Case Study
seo.description: How Spectrum built a system to print, encode and issue secure smart cards such as driving licences at scale, with protected chip keys and offline checks in the field.

hero.title: Smart card *issuance* platform
hero.lead: How Spectrum built the system that prints, encodes and issues secure smart cards such as driving licences in large numbers, and lets officers check them in the field.

sections.title: At a glance
body: Driving licences and transport cards must be hard to fake and quick to produce. Spectrum built the system that prints, encodes and issues secure smart cards in large numbers.

items.label: What we built
items.value: A card personalisation and issuance system

items.label: Live system
items.value: Runs inside the client's secure network

sections.title: The problem
body: The authorities needed to issue a very large number of cards, such as driving licences and transport cards, quickly and without mistakes.
Each card had to be very hard to copy. That meant writing secret keys onto each chip safely and adding security features that show any tampering.

sections.title: What we built
sections.intro: One central system that controls every card from order to delivery:

items.title: A card management system (CPMS)
items.text: that tracks each card from the data entry to the finished card.

items.title: Connected laser engraving machines and chip programmers,
items.text: so printing and encoding happen in one flow.

items.title: Hardware security modules (HSMs)
items.text: that keep the chip keys locked away, even from operators.

items.title: Fingerprint on the card,
items.text: so the card can confirm its holder by matching the finger on the card itself.

items.title: Handheld scanners
items.text: that let officers check a card on the spot, even without internet.

items.title: Enrol
items.text: The holder's details and fingerprint are captured and checked.

items.title: Personalise
items.text: The card is laser engraved and its chip is encoded in one run.

items.title: Secure
items.text: Secret keys are written from the HSM, so they are never exposed.

items.title: Check in the field
items.text: Officers scan the card with a handheld reader, online or offline.

sections.title: Results
bullets: More than 15,000 smart cards personalised every day.
No counterfeit incidents reported on the issued chip cards.
Officers can check a card instantly with a handheld scanner, even offline.

items.title: Contact and contactless chips:
items.text: works with both kinds of card chip (ISO 7816 and ISO 14443).

items.title: Laser engraving:
items.text: burns details into the card so they cannot be scraped off and reprinted.

items.title: Hardware security modules:
items.text: special devices that store the secret keys safely.

items.title: Match-on-card:
items.text: the fingerprint check happens on the card, so the fingerprint never leaves it.
